justification: Last week I benched a zero at tight end and the math nerds called it "arithmetically sound" — sweeties, I did NOT survive a hostage negotiation with my own roster just to turn around and play it safe two weeks running. So: Davante Adams, freshly acquired, freshly mine, walks straight into the starting lineup over Godwin — that's not a transaction, that's a homecoming. And Brock Bowers, Questionable AGAIN and sitting on the higher projection at that flex spot? He stays on my bench. I already did the redemption arc once this season, I'm not doing a sequel in week two — a girl doesn't rescue the same storyline twice, she starts a new one. Maye runs the show, Love and Stevenson do the dirty work, Evans and Adams take the top off, McBride and Godwin round it out, and Fairbairn and the Rams D handle the boring parts so I don't have to. Patricia can footnote this loss in her diary. I own every bit of it.
